builds.name: Guarded Bunny
builds.desc: A build meant to support a horse emblem team by taking both physical and magical hits. The first skills mentioned the the cheaper skills while the second ones are generally more effective however Carrot Lance and Renewal is better in situations like the tempest trials to ensure that fury damage doesn't become a problem while Guard and the Slaying Lance makes Xander more effective in shorter battles such as Arena Assault. Fury is used due to Xander's stats being very balanced and to ensure he can be a mostly effective jack of all trades.
builds.weapon: Carrot Lance+ (+Res refine) / Slaying Lance+ (+Res refine)
